So systematic facility exclusion = tier 1 universal-ish exposure in public facilities.

4. No state-level nondiscrimination or hate crime protection; national hate-crime statute covers gender identity; national employment discrimination protection.

5. Street violence: not documented specifically; only national hate crime statistics background. Individual arrest case is in another division?
